title: Responsive evidence viewer restored
details: Restores the designed evidence viewer with the video held in place while AC timestamps scroll beside it on desktop and beneath it on phones
Keeps every AC timestamp clickable and grouped by Introduction, learning outcome and Witness testimony
Desktop evidence now keeps the original automatic sibling-video load attempt instead of forcing the ZIP picker first

Phone browsers that block local sibling files still require one explicit Open evidence ZIP tap because Android does not allow a webpage to grant itself file access; after that one selection Milos loads the videos and timestamp jumps automatically
The enhanced layout only hides the original timestamp viewer after its own evidence data has loaded successfully, so a presentation failure can no longer leave a blank panel
The proven Milos 2.46 camera/media stack and the reliable installed-app update handover are unchanged
